LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.6: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: how a proper diet is important for wellness. Why should we punctuate written texts clearly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording and write down vocabulary on food items in Chinese (two of each: 水果、蔬菜、肉、饮料、零食),
2. work together to outline

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to Learn: The learner builds on their own learning experiences as they design a healthy plate using various food items

that are useful to the body.

Values:
Respect: The learner exhibits patience when they work collaboratively with others to punctuate the text appropriately.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Healthy eating habits: The learner develops awareness on the importance of a well-balanced diet as they create a healthy plate

with food items that are useful to the body.

Link to other learning areas:

Learner links their learning to Agriculture on the concept of eating a balanced diet for wellness.
